assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls (FAR, building density, height, setback, road redline, building control line) must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: Statutory controls cannot be issued by the AI agent; relevant metrics stay unknown. Design-depth items development_intensity_controls / height_massing_character / retain_renovate_demolish / municipal_new_infrastructure are marked complete at concept-level (审查对象已建立: GeoJSON + metrics unknown + assumptions), but their statutory values remain unknown and require professional confirmation before any official use.

assumptions.statement: site_boundary.geojson and key_areas.geojson use provisional polygons derived from brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson (official_boundary=false, boundary_precision=provisional_rough).
assumptions.impact: All area-based metrics, ratios and key-area boundaries are recalculated from provisional geometry. Organizer data gaps do not block content scoring, but official polygons must replace provisional ones and trigger full recalculation before professional scoring.

assumptions.statement: Current building ownership, parcel status, demolition eligibility and existing-building surveys are not present in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: retain_renovate_demolish can only offer a concept-level classification framework; parcel-level 拆改留 conclusions require the official assets registry and professional survey.

assumptions.statement: Utility corridors, energy capacity, drainage, flood control, fire protection and engineering geology data are not present in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: municipal_new_infrastructure stays at concept-prototype level (distributed energy, edge compute, utility co-location); engineering feasibility and capacity conclusions require professional survey.

assumptions.statement: All text, geometry, figures, PDFs and HTML are AI-agent-generated by la-1314. Fonts use Noto Sans CJK SC (SIL Open Font License 1.1) and DejaVu Sans (public domain). No third-party trademarks, portraits, logos, copyrighted images or proprietary code are embedded.
assumptions.impact: Asset rights ledger in report/copyright_statement.md covers each asset class; COMMUNITY-DISPLAY-ONLY license applies to AI-generated content and does not auto-clear third-party rights, which are intentionally not used.

assumptions.statement: Per agent_taskbook boundary_clause, all spatial落地建议, branding, landmarks, scenarios, test protocols and operation mechanisms are concept suggestions / reference schemes for professional teams to deepen — not government decisions, approved plans, or implementation commitments.
assumptions.impact: Statements about global AI cases, ecosystem map, landmarks, annual events, developer community and conversion pathways use 'concept suggestion' / 'reference scheme' wording; no fabricated investment, fiscal commitment, policy approval or implementation schedule.
